identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18A-HTML] Complete the HTML Observatory Runtime v3 client

values.task_boundary: Implement and prove one governed signed ACIP identity-message contract for authenticated Layer 8-to-agent and direct agent-to-agent communication, including canonical JCS signing, configured per-principal keys, sender and recipient routing, freshness and replay enforcement, recipient-signed acknowledgements, browser delegation without private keys, and the investor-visible live Observatory proof.
deliverables: Live local Runtime v3 HTTPS/WSS browser integration with current capture time and configured Polis identity
Production-admitted Shepherd in the live roster with truthful running status and public verification identity
One RFC 8785/JCS-canonical signed ACIP identity-message contract shared by Layer 8 and agents
Authenticated Layer 8 intent delegation with no browser-held private key and selected-agent signed acknowledgement verification
Direct agent-0001 to agent-0002 binary ACIP exchange with agent-0002 signed acknowledgement verification
Forgery, carrier tamper, wrong or unknown recipient, stale response, future response, replay, restored-replay, and wrong-causation refusal proof
Externally provisioned distinct per-principal communication keys in the versioned production init and lifecycle provisioner
Explicit trust, stale, unavailable, backpressure, and version-mismatch states
Browser reconnect with cleared write authority, bounded replay, and no duplicate application
Live Playwright validation entrypoint and retained browser evidence
acceptance_criteria: The local browser renders the current Runtime v3 capture time, configured Polis name, and roster with Shepherd present as an admitted running agent

Authenticated Layer 8 intent and direct agent-to-agent traffic use the same signed ACIP identity-message fields, RFC 8785/JCS signing bytes, identity registry, routing checks, freshness bounds, nonce, monotonic sequence, replay protection, and recipient-signed acknowledgement
The normal Chat UI holds no private signing key, selects the roster recipient, and verifies the returned acknowledgement against that recipient public key before displaying verified delivery

A production binary ACIP WebSocket proof sends agent-0001 to configured non-Shepherd agent-0002, verifies agent-0002's signed acknowledgement, and rejects signed-body forgery, outer-carrier tamper, unknown recipient, and replay before canonical completion or sequence consumption

Wrong correlation or causation, stale or future acknowledgement, same-process replay, and restored-watermark replay fail closed; Runtime init v2 requires externally provisioned distinct communication identities and the tracked baseline plus lifecycle provisioner supply required keys without embedding secrets

TLS trust, origin refusal, version mismatch, stale data, backpressure, Runtime unavailability, disconnect, and reconnect are visible and never presented as live success; reconnect clears write authority until authenticated again

Live browser proof uses the exact committed Runtime and assets, trusted HTTPS/WSS, no fixture substitution, fresh evidence paths, and retained source revision; no files outside the typed affected-area contract change
dependencies: #5820 stable Runtime launch and API behavior is terminal
#5832 versioned ACIP/A2A and WSS contract is terminal
#92 supplies the Runtime TLS implementation baseline for local trusted development proof
#5837 may consume the completed browser hooks for shared restart coordination but does not gate this lane
non_goals: Runtime launch, TLS, WSS transport, or general authentication redesign
Durable conversation sessions, history, search, rooms, notifications, or cross-Polis messaging owned by #110 children
